The address tie is unverified: the CyrusOne NVA9 page says only "Located in highly desired Loudoun County, VA" (700,000 sq ft, 38 MW) and never mentions Sterling IX or Old Ox Road; the Virginia DEQ data-center permit page returned 403. That Sterling IX equals NVA9 is an inference from CyrusOne listing nine Sterling sites (NVA1-NVA9) against Sterling I-IX in the 10-K.

site_name: Microsoft AVC17 (Lakeside Commerce Park, near Clarksville), 39 Commerce Drive, Boydton mailing address, VA 23917
verification: Leans not yet operating, but no page says so outright, so I am not verifying the status. Evidence for under construction: SoVaNOW Nov 4, 2026 refers to "the Microsoft data center being built nearby" and says it "is being developed at Lakeside Commerce Park"; SoVaNOW Jul 29, 2026 refers to "the Microsoft facility under construction at Lakeside Commerce Park". Evidence that keeps this uncertain: a second Nov 4, 2026 SoVaNOW article says a Chase City official "expects that revenue to grow as Microsoft continues construction and expansion" and did not say how much the town "has received so far", wording that is compatible with a phased campus where a first building is already live; the Nov 4 photo caption reads "Microsoft's data center at the Lakeside Commerce Park in Clarksville." The sentence "One other data center operates in Mecklenburg County near Clarksville" is ambiguous and does not state that Microsoft's is not operating. None of the pages gives an opening or go-live date. The Microsoft community page I tried returned 404. A direct status statement (county certificate of occupancy, Microsoft statement, or a news line saying it is not yet online) is still needed.

lead.notes: SoVaNOW (Nov 4, 2026) says "Microsoft is building a data center near Clarksville", being developed at Lakeside Commerce Park, and adds that "One other data center operates in Mecklenburg County near Clarksville", which implies the Microsoft site is not yet operating. The article does not say so outright, and a first building could be live on a multi-building campus, so the status is uncertain. No non-directory page gives an opening date.
